stock.description: Wah Wo Holdings Group Limited functions as an investment holding entity, specializing in aluminum-related solutions and services across Hong Kong. The company primarily focuses on exterior architectural elements, providing façade works that encompass windows, window wall systems, and curtain wall systems. Furthermore, it offers integrated design and construction, as well as renovation capabilities, catering to a diverse portfolio of structures ranging from residential buildings and commercial properties to retail outlets, academic institutions, and hotels. Their comprehensive project execution covers initial design conceptualization, structural analysis, the creation of detailed shop drawings, and full project management. This oversight extends to the procurement of materials, subcontracting installation tasks, hands-on site supervision, and post-completion support with maintenance services. In addition to its core services, the company also engages in the sale of tools and equipment. Established in 2018, Wah Wo Holdings is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong, and is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ornate Bright Limited.
